Government of Luxembourg: 2015 VAT rise confirmed - 17/14/8 from 1 January 2015, super-reduced 3% unchanged

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

Luxembourg's 17% standard rate is listed by the Commission as still in force (table checked 2026-07-13); a legislated rise to 18% has been discussed in budget bills - re-check when the 2027 budget passes.

The 2015-01-01 rows reflect the 2-point rise of 1 January 2015 (15/12/6 to 17/14/8; the super-reduced 3% rate was unchanged). Under the 2023 solidarity package the standard, intermediate and reduced rates were cut by one point for 2023 (16/13/7) and returned to 17/14/8 on 1 January 2024 (AED Circular 812-1). The super-reduced row is a lower bound: 3% was unchanged in 2015 and applied before, but its true start was not sourced.
